about: Mio's surprised face, round 2 (#576): face-only repaint of the installed neutral's source render, the method of round 1 (mio-surprised-1). Used by tools/characters/steps/face_expr.py.
staging: Round 2: round 1's kept faces read as her neutral at game size (Jørgen's target: clearly surprised at a glance at dialogue size, natural, a little flustered, nothing manic). Beat: Mio is caught off guard by something Eric says or does (train platform, 'Ha, okay. Your turn to look stupid.' and similar); Jørgen 2026-10-14: 'the surprised look from Mio looks deranged, she needs a new surprised face'. Camera and shot are the neutral's, fixed: head and shoulders, eye level, three-quarter turn towards her right (image left), headphones round her neck, plain light background, soft even light. Only the face below the fringe moves: brows (mostly under the fringe) raised, eyes visibly wider than her neutral with normal round irises and pupils (not shrunk), a small open mouth, a faint flush; clearly surprised and a bit flustered, not shocked or manic. Eyeline: at the viewer, as the neutral. Glasses frame kept identical (pasted back). Physical sense: irises stay light tan and inside the lenses, both eyes match, no second lens rim.
